notes.title: Planet Crafter 1.0 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello terraformers! 

Planet Crafter 1.0 is NOW LIVE!

Check out the major differences with the early access version:
[previewyoutube=sqgrpd6YAkQ;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1284190/The_Planet_Crafter/

This 1.0 version is packed with new content:


 New online multiplayer co-op mode up to 10 players
 New big animals creation via DNA manipulation
 3 new biomes
 New lore and end game content
 New character animations
 New cinematic introduction
 Improvements and rework of existing biomes
 New items to craft and new mechanics
 20 new exclusive music tracks
 Quality of life and performances improvements


If you have already purchased the game, it will be automatically updated and existing save files will transfer seamlessly. But with the 30% discount, it's the perfect time to start a new game, alone or with up to 9 friends simultaneously!

After 2 years in Early Access, and 7 major updates in between, we want to thank our amazing community who gave us feedback and helped us trough this journey to make the best 1.0 we could!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373700/27c2f659ad82ae3ed5d38b74657138a67b26661e.gif

We tried to keep true to the promises we made two years ago, and hopefully you'll think we delivered. Some things couldn't be added to the game, like a vehicule, as we felt the map was not well suited and couldn't find the right balance for it yet.

Being a really small team of 6 people for a projet of this scope, we know the game is not 100% perfect yet, but we do our best to make clear decisions. We will continue to improve the game in the future as we still have a lot of ideas for new and exciting content!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373700/2a472693ee03fe35c267494e9a3dfad1340d0c87.png

We are really excited to finally share this with you and we sincerelly hope you'll enjoy your journey!
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1284190/The_Planet_Crafter/

Press Kit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373700/0296f635374ef9415760c1183da1ff26a91bc72c.png

1.0 Full changelog : 

New multiplayer mode : 
		
 Play with your friends, from one to more than 10 players! 
 		There is no real max number of players. It will depends on the host computer and internet speed.
 		There is no dedicated server. Just launch the game and invite your friends to have fun!
 		It's recommended to start a new save for a better multiplayer experience, but you can invite your friends in your existing saves

	New creatures mechanics : 
		
 You can now create creatures by combining DNA from different living things
 		First : using the DNA extractor, extract some DNA from a variety of living things, like larvaes, eggs or seeds
 		Then : using the DNA synthesizer, create a dna sequence with the chosen genetic traits
 		Finally : create an animal shelter to spawn your creatures
 		You can create an infinite number of creature variations depending on your liking
 		You can pet your creatures!

	New objects for mammals :

 Genetic extractor
 		Genetic synthesizer
 		Animal shelter
 		Animal feeder
 		More than 50 Genetic traits
 		DNA Sequence
 		Animals rocket

	New objects : 
		
 Jetpack T4
 		Backpack T6
 		Deconstruct chip t3 - deconstruct quicker - unlock via blueprints chip
 		Pin chip - allows to pin 5 recipes - unlock via blueprints chip
 		Light t3 - better light - unlock via blueprints chip

	World : 
		
 3 new biomes : Cascades, Grasslands, Rainbow caves
 		Improve the evolution of multiple existing biomes
 		Fix a lot of problem with textures and flying resources
		
	Lore :	
		
 It's now possible to end the game
	
	Misc : 
		
 New introduction cinematic
 		15 new achievements
 		20 new music tracks
 		Ability to sit on chairs

	Quality of life: 
		
 Improve snapping of pod habitat, especially big ones
 		It's now possible to name the save file on new game creation
 		Improve performances of multiple objects
 		"Supply all" button for logistics

	Balance : 
		
 Increase some fuses multiplier from 250 to 500
 		Reduce terra tokens loot in wrecks

	Localization : 
		
 Improve the overall localization for all languages
 		Add Traditionnal Chinese, Turkish and Italian localization

notes.title: "Fish & Drones" Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello Terraformers!

The "Fish & Drones" Update is now available for everyone!

The terraformation of your planet will go even further with the introduction of fish  that you'll be able to breed in the incubator or find in the wild! 

Did you like the autocrafter of the previous update? You will love the new drones and logistics that will allow you to transfer items from inventories across the map easily, allowing you to automate everything! 

With this new logistics system, the ore extractor t3 lost the need be able to mine anything anywhere. So all the newly placed ore extractor t3 will now extract ore depending on their positioning (same as t1 & t2). Your old extractors t3 will keep digging what they were digging, but we recommend to reset your old extractors to fully enjoy the new drones.

We took a bit more time to fix bugs, so we are delivering this update one day after schedule, but we think it was for the best. 

Check out the trailer:

[previewyoutube=A4zwemH_P2Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Your save files will transfer seamlessly to the update. But if you want to try a fresh adventure, feel free to create a new game  to fully experience this update!

The goal of this update is giving more toys to play to people who want to spend hours into the game,
while at the same time, making sure the new fish terraformation stage does not require heavy machinery, and shouldn't be too hard to achieve, as we want to avoid grind for the more casual players.

Balancing the experience of a game with so much things to unlock and progression is difficult, and we try our best to keep the experience enjoyable trough the terraformation process, for new players and old ones.

Amélie & I really hope you will like this update, and that the work we put into it during the last months will pay out!

Thanks once again to everyone supporting us, giving feedback, reviewing the game, and sending us good vibes!

Happy terraforming!


If your game is not up to date, restart Steam to download the latest version (v0.7.007)

notes.title: Happy new year from Miju Games to all terraformers!
notes.content:
Hello terraformers! 

First of all, Brice & I wish you all an amazing year 2023! 

2022 has been a great year for Miju Games, and we are really glad Planet Crafter received such an overwhelming reception!

We will continue to focus mainly on Planet Crafter during the year 2023 and after that. 
We still have a lot of ideas for the game and we want to bring it to the next level during this new year.

We kept our promise to give you an update every 2-3 months last year, and we'll do our best to continue providing quality content untill the full 1.0 release.

The next update

In order to prepare the future of the game, refine our workflow and find talents that will help us improve Planet Crafter even more, we worked on a lot of things that were not directly related to the next update during the last 3 months.

Because of this, we are now aiming for the end of february for the next update. This little delay will give us more time to add meaningfull content to it.

Roadmap Update

So here's an updated roadmap for the year to come. Of course, this is not a final version, and it can change depending on how things go. We'll update it during the year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373700/c39ee764f7c4ff8880d485d461a6a7f26ad662f0.png

And we plan to continue maintaining the game even after the release with free updates and DLC's.

So if you like Planet Crafter, rejoice, there's a lot more to come!

notes.title: Planet Crafter Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hello terraformers!

Small performance update

One difficulty with base building games will always be performance. As you create amazing outposts with hundred of machines and a lot of vegetation, the framerate will undoubtedly suffer. 

To support the creation of beautifull planets, we just uploaded a new version with some engine optimizations. Depending on your save file and computer, you should see some FPS improvements. (Full changelog at the end of this post)

Feel free to let us know if you saw some FPS boost!

Planet Crafter on Geforce Now and GOG

Since the launch of the game, we had a lot of request from the community to be able to experience it differently. So during the past few weeks, we partnered with GOG and GeforceNow to let you play Planet Crafter on this Platforms!

Get Planet Crafter on GOG.

The next big update

We are currently focusing on the next big update, and development is going pretty well. We want to add a lot of content in this one, and our goal is to deliver it before the end of july.

We can't really tell you exactly what it will contain yet, but here's a super secret sneak peek :

notes.title: The new update is on the way!
notes.content:
Hello terraformers! 

We are currently working on the next update for the game, it will focus on expending the map and adding lots of Quality of Life improvements. As always, it will include new objects to build and craft, new technologies and new secrets. 

It should be ready in the next few weeks, so in the meantime, here's a sneek peak: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373700/7e699acde632dc57cbe676f28f547cf2f31a0fb8.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373700/e5dca00ce831bb39a9fb4c967e80dc3d01869e9f.png

notes.title: The future of Planet Crafter
notes.content:
Hello terraformers! 

Today, we want to share with you what we have in mind for the future of the game. What the game will and won't be. We are dedicated to bringing our vision to life, and even tough the Early Access launch was a great success for us, we are determined to complete the game and give players an 1.0 within a reasonnable time period.

Do something simple, do it well

One of our main objective is to respect people who trusted us by purchasing the game in Early Access. We want to prove Early Access can work, rewarding people who supported our studio. We don’t want to overpromise without delivering, we know what we are capable of and what we are not. So we won't make big promises we won't keep. We want to do something simple, but do it very well. 

The team will remain fairly small, and the scope of the game won't become too crazy, the price will reflect this by staying relatively low. If you followed the development untill the release of EA, you know this allowed us to create great content fairly quickly while listening to the community feedback.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373700/6b248133c71924f69d9b593dd61a334becc2f76f.png
Our vision for the game

We are thrilled that the game receive a incredible rating of 95% Overwhelmingly positive reviews on Steam, meaning that you, the players, are really understanding what we are doing with the game. Let just say that if you like the game already, you'll like it even more at 1.0. That's the reason we share a demo with more than 3 hours of content, so players can know if the game is for them, or not.

We want the final game to be: 

  a 30h to 60h relaxing experience about terraforming a planet, 
  where players see it evolves while exploring a big map, 
  discovering secrets and the story of the planet, 
  taking inspiration in real science, but without being hyper realistic
  with replayability options for people who want to enjoy it multiple times

Updates
We will regularly add updates during the early access period, we don't have an exact planning to share yet, but here is what is garanteed to be in the 1.0 version : 

 A way bigger map, at least 50% bigger
 One vehicle
 A complete story arc and some procedural story elements
 Terraforming stages: Breathable atmosphere / Insects / Fishes / Amphibians
 More environmental threats
 Replayability options
 QoL elements and optimization

For each update, we will add new technologies, special events, increase the map size, add secrets. Of course, we have other surprises in our sleeve and won't spoil everything here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373700/1dd24ac074ab3489adcac2d5a0a5c0ee8e594003.png
What won't be in the game

As we are a small indie studio, we won't make the next AAA game, so some things, as previously said, will never be in the game: 

Big monsters and aliens, guns, fighting and violence
Interplanetary roaming, spaceship piloting
Really complex systems, and completly accurate science
Realistic and next-gen graphics

Multiplayer and procedural maps

Even tough we know a lot of people want to play Planet Crafter with friends, making a multiplayer game can bring a lot of bugs, instabilities and greatly decrease the overall gameplay. We first want to make sure that the single player experience is perfect before commiting to anything else. If this ever happens it will be after 1.0.

The same is true for procedural generation of the map. We will stick to a handmade map, allowing us to pace the experience of players, their discoveries and keep the map interesting while including the different terraforming stages with great details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373700/9e70e22ae1fb09f1126ae4bdd453a176db4f4e3f.png
After 1.0 launch

Once our vision for 1.0 is done, we will come back to you with a new plan. We are confident that we'll keep adding content to the game after the 1.0 release and, with the help of the community, we will then work on a new roadmap.

Our goal is to release the 1.0 fairly quickly, between one and two years from now, releasing at least one update every 2-3 months.

So you can expect a big update before the end of may, and several small patches untill then.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1284190/The_Planet_Crafter/

notes.title: Planet Crafter Early Access annoucement!
notes.content:
Hello Terraformers! 

Finally, Amélie & I are happy to announce the date for the Early Access release of Planet Crafter! You’ll be able to get your hands on the game on March 24th 2022, in less than a month! 

What will the Early Access contain compared to the demo / prologue ?

 New terraforming stages : Moss / Grass / Trees
 3 new areas to explore and discover, new wrecks and secret caves
 More than 15 new machines, new ores, new equipments, new decorations
 Steam achievements
 New game modes (chill / standard / intense / hardcore)
 New landing sites
 New meteo events, story elements and secrets!


Check out the release teaser : 
[previewyoutube=0LJgmnCYRhc;full][/previewyoutube]


We recommend starting a new game with the Early Access version, but we are trying to make it so that your previous save files will still work. We can’t guarantee it for now, but we’ll do our best to make it happen.

The development branches will be removed some days before launch, but the prologue and demo will stay. A massive thank you to everyone who helped us find all the bugs and provided us with amazing feedback. It has helped us tremendously!

If you want to help us bring the game to your language, feel free to participate in the community localization on localizor.

The price at launch will be 19.99 US$, we’ll add a special launch discount for the first week, so be sure to get it as soon as it’s out!

We can’t wait to give you access to this version, and see how you will terraform your planet, which kind of trees you’ll plant, and how your planet will turn out!



See you soon, and good terraforming !
